knowledge_gaps: The architecture ablation is confounded: adding LayerNorm changes baseline SASRec even when the residual gate is zero. Specify normalization, embedding scaling, gate initialization, padding masks, and a baseline-preserving control.

Negative sampling excludes each user's training history, but train_loader provides None instead of user IDs. Explain how exclusions are constructed, how variable negative counts are masked, and how sampling without replacement affects the sampled-softmax objective.

Five recent interactions need not be recent in elapsed time. The residual could amplify recently satisfied purchases, and repeated-item benefits depend on whether preprocessing preserves repeated interactions. These mechanisms remain untested.

The report lacks baseline validation HR@10, a concrete allocation of the 43,200 GPU-second budget, optimizer settings, checkpoint-selection rules, and an explicit final four-dataset selection procedure. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category risks validation overfitting.

Raw margins depend on score scale and negative sampling; cross-dataset comparisons do not establish where architectural changes will help most. Originality 5 and potential 8 are subjective and optimistic without measured gains; difficulty 4 omits unresolved sampler integration and runtime costs.
